ci_support_linux_64_.yaml:
DOCKER_PLATFORM:
- linux/amd64
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
python_min:
- '3.11'

about.description:
The 'tsgettoolbox_daymet' is a plugin-in for 'tsgettoolbox' that supplies
a command line interface and Python library to get time-series data from the
Daymet dataset.  The Daymet dataset is a gridded dataset of daily weather
parameters for North America, including temperature, precipitation, humidity,
and solar radiation.  The tsgettoolbox_daymet plugin allows users to easily
access and retrieve time-series data from the Daymet dataset using either the
command line or Python library.
about.summary: Plugin for tsgettoolbox to retrieve Daymet data from the Daymet REST API.

name: tsgettoolbox-daymet
raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  version: 27.0.0

package:
  name: tsgettoolbox-daymet
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
- url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/t/tsgettoolbox-daymet/tsgettoolbox_daymet-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 4f6f236908a3ecd6ab164259bc48eccdbdc3efe6cdbdd6d54d07e62ad45f198c

build:
  number: 0
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install .
  noarch: python

requirements:
  host:
  - python ${{ python_min }}.*
  - setuptools >=80
  - pip
  run:
  - python >=${{ python_min }}
  - aiodns >3.6.0
  - async_retriever
  - pandas
  - pydantic >=2
  - tsgettoolbox >=27.0.0

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
      - tsgettoolbox_daymet
      pip_check: true
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}.*
        - "*"

about:
  summary: Plugin for tsgettoolbox to retrieve Daymet data from the Daymet REST API.
  description: |
    The 'tsgettoolbox_daymet' is a plugin-in for 'tsgettoolbox' that supplies
    a command line interface and Python library to get time-series data from the
    Daymet dataset.  The Daymet dataset is a gridded dataset of daily weather
    parameters for North America, including temperature, precipitation, humidity,
    and solar radiation.  The tsgettoolbox_daymet plugin allows users to easily
    access and retrieve time-series data from the Daymet dataset using either the
    command line or Python library.
  homepage: https://pypi.org/project/tsgettoolbox_daymet/
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file:
    - LICENSE.txt

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - timcera
